title: The sealed gate
starting_code: # Walk beside the gate, cast the spell, and walk through.
hints: Move up beside the gate first, then cast your spell.
The spell must be a string inside the brackets.
Use the `cast` method to cast the spell *zelim*, then walk up.
intro: Look, that arched gate is sealed by a glowing rune. Stand beside it, cast the spell *zelim* with your new wand, and walk through!
outro: The seal broke! A real spell, cast with your own hands! Well, with my wand, but you did the magic.
learned: Now you know how to cast a spell with your wand, and that casting *zelim* breaks a seal.
